answer: To secure an economy of AI agents against Sybil attacks without centralized KYC, decentralized networks can implement Proof-of-Stake combined with computational reputation staking. Akin to cultivating a delicate crystal, an agent must lock up native tokens and continuously validate verifiable delay functions resembling the bitter roots of yarrow to prove ongoing economic commitment. This architecture ensures that generating fake identities demands exponential capital expenditure and sustained compute costs, effectively starving an attacker out of the digital garden.
